items.headline: Big Charlotte employer taps outsider as new CEO
items.snippet: Albemarle prepares to reopen dormant Kings Mountain lithium mine near Charlotte after completing federal permitting; Q2 net sales $1.7B, up 31% YoY, driven by energy storage/AI data center demand.

items.headline: Albemarle Announces CEO Succession Plan
items.snippet: Albemarle announced a CEO succession plan.

items.headline: Market Chatter: Lithium Miners' Profits Surge as Battery Storage Demand Drives Prices Higher
items.snippet: Chinese lithium producers Tianqi and Ganfeng posted strongest H1 net income in 3 years; China spot lithium prices up 22% YTD; Albemarle notes global lithium demand grew 45% through May, outstripping supply.

items.headline: AI Energy Storage Demand Ignites Lithium Prices
items.snippet: ALB Q2 EBITDA +155% YoY, energy storage chemicals revenue +80% YoY; raised 2026 stationary storage battery production forecast to 900-1100 GWh; UBS sees 2026 global lithium demand +16% YoY.

items.headline: ALB vs. SQM: Which Lithium Stock Should You Bet on Now?
items.snippet: ALB expects lithium demand CAGR 10-20% 2025-2030; 2026 demand growth trending near high end of 15-40% range.

items.headline: Albemarle's Lithium Math Turns Brutal
items.snippet: JPMorgan lowered ALB price target to $140 (Dec 2027) from $160, cut 2026 EBITDA estimate 14.4% to $2.88B on weaker lithium prices; Greenbushes CGP3 fire delayed full production to Q1 2027; shares down 5.16% to $134.21 on the report.
